sources.entry: YOURLS - YOURLS is a set of PHP scripts that will allow you to run Your Own URL Shortener. Features include password protection, URL customization, bookmarklets, statistics, API, plugins, jsonp. (Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: YOURLS is a set of PHP scripts for running your own self-hosted URL shortener on your own server.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes YOURLS as a PHP script collection that lets you run a URL shortener on your own server, with full control over your data. It mentions detailed stats, analytics, and plugins. The awesome-selfhosted listing adds that it offers password protection, URL customization, bookmarklets, statistics, an API, plugins, and JSONP support. The README itself is mostly links to documentation, community resources, and contribution guidelines, so it gives few implementation details.
use_cases: shorten links on my own domain
track click statistics for short links
how_to_run: Read the installation documentation at docs.yourls.org
notable: Full control over data on your own server
Plugin system, with community plugins listed on Awesome YOURLS
Bookmarklets and JSONP support, per the awesome-selfhosted listing
caveats: README gives no install steps; setup is described only through external documentation
Requires running a PHP server you manage yourself
